name: A child's library book
vera_note: Picture book about a bear who loses a button. The bear's expression on every page is politely devastated. Someone has written 'PROPERTY OF THE LIBRARY' on the inside front cover with a stamp, and then below that, in a child's handwriting: 'actually mine.' The due date slip in the back pocket shows three renewals. Then a gap. The last renewal date is four years before the last renewal would have been possible. It was not returned.
